# Documentation Guidance

`AGENTS.md` is the source of truth. Keep startup, validation, git, and handoff
rules aligned with the Agent Startup Contract instead of duplicating long rule
sets.

Documentation-only changes require no repository validation script. Keep
`Agentic/SessionState.md` short and move durable history to plans, reports,
audits, or reference docs.
